text: This report is to advise the Board of the recent Request for Proposal ("RFP") evaluation process and an award to enter into a consulting agreement with Optimus SBR ("Optimus") for the provision of facilitator services for the development of the 2022-2026 Strategic Plan for Exhibition Place.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (February 4, 2021) from the Chief Executive Office, Exhibition Place for information.
